posts.title: In Memoriam: Paul Sanasardo (1928–2026)
posts.description: One of the fascinating dancer/choreographers of mid-20th-century American modern dance, Paul Sanasardo died on July 23 at the age of 97. He made works in the intense expressionist mode of Anna Sokolow, co-created an experimental space called the Studio for Dance, and taught rigorous technique classes for decades.
